evals.prompt: I just changed the description on the idea-discovery skill. Check its eval coverage.
evals.expected_output: Runs node skills/skill-evals/run-evals.js idea-discovery from the repository root, reports the validation summary, and cites any exact file/field errors. Does not modify eval files, run Jest, or start live checks.

evals.prompt: Validate all skill eval files and tell me which skills are missing suites.
evals.expected_output: Runs the offline runner with no filter, lists discovered suites and warnings for skills with missing or incomplete eval files, exits non-zero only on structural errors, and makes no network or LLM calls.
